package.name: nepi_gazebo_plugins
package.description: Gazebo model plugins for NEPI simulated robots. First plugin: nepi_crab_steer_plugin, for the 4-wheel rover's "wheel independence" (crab-steering) dimension option -- drives the rover's actual body-frame translation physics and publishes its odometry itself (2026-09-23: dropped the stock libgazebo_ros_planar_move plugin this used to run alongside for that job -- it crashed gzserver outright on every respawn, see crab_steer_plugin.cpp's own header comment), in addition to its original job of animating the 4 wheel corners to visually steer+spin consistent with that motion. See sim_container/scripts/generate_model_sdf.py's buildRoverSdf for the SDF wiring that references this plugin's built .so.
